incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — KV cache fragmentation causing continuous-batching memory climb on contbatch-pool-3. Error rate spike ~8% and intermittent GPU OOMs. Pager triggered.

sanjay: I'm paged, taking it. what's the user impact?

elena: seeing p50/p95 latency climb and sporadic OOMs on g4/g5 hosts. kv_frag_ratio up to 0.42, free_arena down to ~12%.

miguel: CS reports 3 customers with elevated 500s for generation endpoints (acct-123, acct-987, acct-555).

sanjay: ok. immediate mitigation: throttle continuous batching and reduce max_batch_tokens. I'll push a temporary config to contbatch pools.

deploy-bot: roll config change applied: batch_throttle=4, max_batch_tokens=2048 -> contbatch-pool-3 (rolling).

thao: can we run arena compaction on a canary host to reclaim fragmentation? I can take 3a.

sanjay: yes. do dry-run first, then full. share commands.

thao: running dry-run:
```
ssh ops@contbatch-3a
sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference
/opt/redwood/bin/arena_compact --dry-run --log=compact.2026-03-15.log
```

thao: dry-run shows ~40GB reclaimable. starting full compact now.

thao: running full compaction... reclaimed 42.1GB, restarting service.

elena: good. but logs still show occasional cudaMalloc failures: 
```
E cuda_driver.cc: failed to allocate 134217728 bytes: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
E inference/runtime/kv_cache.cc: kv_arena_alloc returned null, fragmentation=0.48
```

miguel: that pattern points at allocator inability to satisfy large contiguous allocs despite free total. PyTorch/CUDA splitting behaviour probably contributing.

sanjay: hotfix trial: set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF on canary to favor smaller splits + GC threshold. Applying: `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=garbage_collection_threshold:0.8,max_split_size_mb:32`.

deploy-bot: env var set on contbatch-3a. Restarting process.

thao: container restarted. immediate logs show no new cudaMalloc errors. kv_frag_ratio down to 0.18 on 3a.

customer-support: acct-123 reports errors dropping ~90% after ~6m.

sanjay: excellent. next, apply conservative global changes while we investigate root cause: 1) globally reduce batch size by 20% 2) enable aggressive KV eviction (short ttl) for 10m 3) enable continuous compact opportunistically between requests.

deploy-bot: applied batch_size_multiplier=0.8, kv_eviction_policy=aggressive, kv_eviction_ttl=10m across contbatch pools.

jamie: that will increase token cost a bit but keeps customers online. logging for cost analysis started.

elena: monitoring shows error rate down to 1.2% and p95 latency returning to baseline. GPU memory headroom improving.

miguel: longer term fixes: arena slab rebalancing, backport allocator improvements from runtime-2.1 (better coalescing), and add periodic compaction job.

sanjay: filing followup tickets and assigning owners. action items:
- MIGUEL: memory profiling + runtime backport ticket
- JAMIE: cost impact analysis + customer comms
- THAO: scheduled compaction automation and canary playbook

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated. Severity: high -> reduced. Mitigations applied: batch throttling, env tweak, arena compaction, eviction policy.

sanjay: handing off monitoring to night oncall @thao at 22:00 UTC. If OOMs recur escalate to oncall lead @elena.

thao: taking over. I'll keep dashboards open for 2h and run compaction on any node that crosses frag_ratio>0.3.

customer-support: logged all affected customer tickets and added incident reference. CS will follow up with impacted customers and offer credits if SLA breach is confirmed.

sanjay: thanks all. please capture logs + memory heap dumps for the postmortem. closing this thread once postmortem is published.
